forbidden_fields: any node identity, taxon identity, interaction edge, interaction type/value, trait value, environmental value
purpose: Determine whether Mangal contains enough independently replicated georeferenced network programmes to justify opening the interaction arm.

qualification.rationale: The generalized interaction stratum requires at least 12 independent network programmes before cross-system time-space synthesis is worth opening; each spatial programme needs at least five georeferenced networks under the frozen interaction-system gate.

next_gate_if_pass: Freeze dataset-level node/taxon support audit using identities only; still do not open interaction edges.
next_gate_if_hold: Stop Mangal primary route without inspecting node or interaction outcomes; GloBI may be considered only under the finite-family source-switch rule.
